Runbook RB-WF-07 Job backlog. 1) Confirm backlog growth and compare job creation rate with acquisition rate. 2) Check executor busy vs max threads. 3) Check DB connection pool and slow queries. 4) Check failed-job/retry rates and downstream dependencies. 5) Review recent deployments for pool, retry or acquisition setting changes; a nearby deployment is a clue, not proof.
